prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Atlanta for a dental implant?
competitors_mentioned: Dr. Carlos Castro at Georgia Prosthodontics
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” implant dentist for everyone. For a complex case or a second opinion, **Dr. Carlos Castro at Georgia Prosthodontics** is a strong Atlanta option to consider: he is listed as a **board-certified prosthodontist** and has additional implant-dentistry training. The practice is in Buckhead at **3379 Peachtree Rd NE, Suite 830**.

You could also compare **Dr. Hal N. Arnold**, another Atlanta prosthodontist listed as a Diplomate of the American Board of Prosthodontics. A prosthodontist is especially relevant when the implant needs complex restoration or full-mouth planning; a periodontist or oral surgeon may handle the surgical placement, sometimes in coordination with your restorative dentist.

Before choosing, get a consultation and ask who will place the implant and make the crown, what alternatives are appropriate, what the full cost includes, and how they handle complications. Verify credentials and get a second opinion if the plan is extensive.
